summary: A cleaned, downloadable CSV of Texas-licensed trade contractors sourced directly from the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) public bulk download. TDLR licenses 30+ trade categories; the highest-value niches for B2B outreach are HVAC/AC contractors (~15,000 records), licensed electricians (~100,000 records), and plumbers. The Texas Open Data Portal hosts a daily-updated 'TDLR All Licenses' dataset as a direct CSV download with zero authentication required. Third-party vendors (Scrap.io, AverickMedia) sell roofing and contractor email lists at $0.10–$2.00/contact; a one-time state-verified, license-confirmed file at $39–$59 targets the trade SaaS vendor and material supplier audience that pays for accurate contractor outreach lists.

audience.who: B2B vendors selling tools or materials to licensed trade contractors: field service and trade SaaS platforms (ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, FieldEdge), HVAC equipment distributors and manufacturers (Carrier, Trane, Lennox dealer networks), electrical supply wholesalers, commercial insurance brokers writing contractor liability policies, and marketing agencies with contractor vertical clients.

data_wanted: License holder name (individual or business), license type (ACR Contractor, Electrician — Master/Journeyman, Plumber, etc.), license number, status (Active), city, state, ZIP, phone (where in public record), license expiration date — sourced from TDLR bulk download at data.texas.gov (daily updated, no authentication) and tdlr.texas.gov/LicenseSearch/licfile.asp.

willingness_to_pay.signal: Competitor lists at $0.10–$2.00/contact for 30,000–90,000 records means buyers already spend hundreds to thousands on outreach lists. A one-time $39–$59 CSV of 15,000–25,000 state-verified, license-confirmed Texas HVAC or electrical contractors is cheaper per record AND more trustworthy (licensed = verified, active business) than Google Maps or aggregator scrapes sold by Scrap.io and AverickMedia.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + Reddit r/HVAC, r/electricians, r/SaaS (trade software angle), LinkedIn targeting ServiceTitan/Housecall Pro SDRs and HVAC distributor reps
first_sale_path.angle: "Texas Licensed HVAC Contractors 2026 — 15,000+ State-Verified Companies, CSV" — license number, status, city, phone, ready to import. Unique angle vs. scrape-based competitors: 'Every company on this list holds an active Texas state license — not just a Google Maps pin. Verified. Current. One payment.' Launch HVAC first (highest-value niche for SaaS vendors), then electricians as second SKU.
